summary: Verified the FIFO bug-fix on GarlicLedger Pro (RN-Web/Expo). All 4 scenarios in the review request passed exactly. Cleared IndexedDB first, then created fresh customers via UI with backdated sales (Aug 2026) using the sale-date calendar picker. The primary bug — 13 Aug wrongly Pending while 15 Aug PAID — no longer reproduces: money now allocates oldest-first across ALL incoming amounts including sale.initialReceived.

FifoPay_separate_payment.input: 10 Aug ₹100 received 0; 12 Aug ₹100 received 0; then Receive Payment ₹150

AdvKeep_overpay_both.input: 10 Aug ₹100 received 100; 11 Aug ₹120 received 200 (total received 300, billed 220)

critical_code_review_comments: ledger.ts computeCustomerLedger is correct: events sorted by (date, createdAt) then a single FIFO allocate() applies to ALL incoming money (sale.initialReceived AND payment.amount), with pre-existing advance applied first via applyAdvance(). Rounding uses EPS=0.0001 with round2, consistent throughout.
The intentional behaviour reversal from iteration 4 (own-bill money can now overflow to earlier open bills) is implemented cleanly and matches the product spec.
Only pre-existing console noise: RN-Web 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and Animated 'useNativeDriver' warnings — no uncaught errors, no red-box screens observed.
seed_data_creation: Created via UI in a freshly cleared IndexedDB: ShabbirTest (3 sales), FifoPay (2 sales + 1 receive payment), AdvKeep (2 sales), AdvNext (2 sales). Data lives inside the Playwright browser context only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The FIFO oldest-first allocation is verified end-to-end. Backdating via sale-date picker: click the picker, then use the chevron pressables around the 'Month YYYY' header text to navigate months (each chevron is a Pressable child of the header row); click day by exact text. Preview URL: https://app-audit-report-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Clear IndexedDB via evaluate before each fresh scenario. Use unique customer names to avoid indexeddb collisions.
rca of the issue: Original bug: sale.initialReceived was applied to its own bill only, so a partially-paid newer sale could sit as PAID while an older bill remained pending. Fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/ledger.ts: the engine now flows every incoming money event (sale-initial-received + separate payment) through a single allocate() that consumes open bills insertion-ordered (== chronological FIFO), with any leftover becoming advance. Pre-existing advance is drained via applyAdvance() before the new bill's own received is allocated. Verified via ShabbirTest: 240+170+240=650 -> 10 Aug fills 240 (paid), 13 Aug fills 240 (paid), 15 Aug fills 170 (Pending ₹70) — exactly matching expected FIFO output.
